hero.title:
Always in
our element
hero.text: Discover an SUV that combines distinctive design, a spacious interior and electric drive with extended range.
hero.life_text: For those who value taste over noise, a classic is never out of place: it simply feels right.
hero.life_alt: A yellow V27 parked on a clay tennis court, seen from above

statement.text: What is truly classic doesn't fade with time: it grows into everyday life. We don't look back. We build cars where enduring design meets new energy intelligence.
statement.more: We don't chase extreme specs at the expense of real experience. We don't trade safety for a fashionable outline. And we don't overload features at the cost of long-term reliability.
statement.more_alt: A sand-coloured V27 parked in a pine forest, seen from a hammock

items.label: i-AWD
items.title: One motor per axle
items.text: 150 kW at the front, 185 kW at the rear. All-wheel drive splits the power on its own, on tarmac and on sand.
items.alt: Top view of the V27 platform with its two electric motors

items.label: REEV
items.title: Electric, without range anxiety
items.text: The Golden REEV system takes the V27 from 0 to 100 km/h in 5.9 seconds. The engine reaches 45.79% thermal efficiency and only works to recharge the battery.
items.alt: Engine of the Golden REEV range extender system

items.label: Safety
items.title: A steel cage around you
items.text: 11 transverse and 11 longitudinal beams, hot-formed steel at 39 key points and 32,186 N·m/deg of torsional rigidity.
items.alt: High-rigidity cage body of the V27

meta.title: iCAUR V27 — All-round hybrid SUV
meta.description: iCAUR V27: classic boxy design, Golden REEV system, 0–100 km/h in 5.9 s, 505 N·m and one of the roomiest cabins in its class.

hero.text: Rugged looks and timeless design. Nearly five metres in length, all-wheel drive and advanced hybrid technology for uncompromising freedom of movement.

steps.title: Retro meets tech
steps.text: Round headlights with the Star Halo light ring and separate turn signals: a classic face with today's details.
steps.alt: V27 seen from the front, in the studio

steps.title: Classic boxy shape
steps.text: A 1:1 width-to-height ratio, vertical lines, wide wheel arches and 21-inch wheels.
steps.alt: V27 seen from the front three-quarter

steps.title: Sculpted surfaces
steps.text: Scoop cuts in the bodywork catch the light and give depth to a bold silhouette.

steps.title: Imposing proportions
steps.text: A large body that stands out and leaves plenty of room for everyone inside.
steps.alt: V27 seen from the rear three-quarter

steps.title: Power tailgate
steps.text: Hands full? A gentle push is all it takes: it closes on its own, smoothly and quietly.
steps.alt: V27 seen from behind with the spare wheel on the tailgate

steps.title: Starry Sky dual roof
steps.text: Two glass panels bring the sky into the cabin, in the city or out in the wild.
steps.alt: V27 seen from above with its dual glass roof

items.title: Star Halo light signature
items.text: It lights the road and makes the V27 recognisable in the dark: every time it turns on, it draws a ring of light.
items.alt: V27 headlight with the light ring switched on

items.title: 21-inch wheels
items.text: Sized to the body for a stable ride on the road. Wide wheel arches protect the sides when the road runs out.
items.alt: V27 21-inch wheel and flared wheel arch

items.title: Fixed side steps
items.text: Getting in and out is easy for everyone, young and old, and the side line stays clean.
items.alt: V27 fixed side step

items.title: Flared fenders
items.text: They give the V27 a solid, confident stance: the line looks more dynamic and the bodywork is protected off-road.
items.alt: Flared front fender of the sand-coloured V27

items.title: Power-operated tailgate
items.text: Effortless elegance when your hands are full. A gentle push is all it takes for the tailgate to close quietly and smoothly, blocking out the noise and delivering an understated premium experience in every detail.
items.alt: V27 rear light cluster and tailgate handle

items.title: Separate turn signals
items.text: Function and looks stay apart: independent indicators show your intentions clearly and add a modern touch to the classic silhouette.
items.alt: Separate turn signal on the V27 front fender

interior.title:
Advanced tech,
living-room warmth
interior.text: Tan leather, horizontal lines and a 15.4-inch centre screen. Everything is where you expect it.
interior.alt: V27 dashboard seen from the driver's side, with tan leather steering wheel and central screen
interior.cabin_alt: Side view of the V27 cabin with tan leather seats

cockpit.label: 15.4-inch central screen
cockpit.title: 15.4" 2.5K screen
cockpit.text: Qualcomm 8155 chip, voice control, OTA updates (with active connectivity) and Driver Monitoring System (DMS).
cockpit.alt: V27 dashboard with the central screen

cockpit.label: Seven one-tap modes
cockpit.title: Seven modes, one tap
cockpit.text: Nap, Sentinel, Camping, off-vehicle battery protection and more: switch with a single tap.

cockpit.label: Power driver's seat
cockpit.title: Power driver's seat
cockpit.text: Six-way adjustment with memory and welcome function: every driver finds their position in a moment.

cockpit.label: Starry Sky roof
cockpit.title: Starry Sky roof
cockpit.text: The dual glass roof brings light and sky into the cabin, among skyscrapers or out in the wild.
cockpit.alt: V27 from above with the dual glass roof

cabin.label: Trunk
cabin.title: Largest trunk in its class
cabin.text: 715 litres with the second row upright, 1818 litres with it reclined and a 40-litre compartment under the floor.

cabin.label: Second-row space
cabin.title: Largest second row in its class
cabin.text: 950 mm of knee room and 1357 mm from floor to ceiling: the second row travels in comfort.

cabin.label: Flat-folding seats
cabin.title: Second row down, bedroom up
cabin.text: One tap folds the rear seats flat: a sleeping area for camping or a huge space for bulky loads.
cabin.alt: V27 load area with the rear seats folded flat

space.title:
Room to spare,
no rush
space.note: Manufacturer data. Class-leading values according to iCAUR.
space.head: Headroom: 1110 mm front, 1116 mm rear. There's an extra 40-litre compartment under the boot floor.

comfort.title: The small pleasures of the journey

items.title: Ventilated and heated
items.text: The only model in its class with ventilation on both cushion and backrest, plus seat heating.
items.alt: Driver's seat in tan leather

items.title: 15 speakers
items.text: Carefully tuned surround sound: every journey gets its soundtrack.
items.alt: Top view of the cabin with the speakers highlighted

items.title: Fragrance diffuser
items.text: Replaceable refills to pick the scent of each journey.
items.alt: Fragrance diffuser on the dashboard

items.title: Thermal armrest box
items.text: Keeps summer drinks cold and winter coffee warm.
items.alt: Centre console with the thermal armrest

items.title: Fully reclining seat
items.text: While you wait or charge, lay the backrest flat and take a break.
items.alt: V27 cabin seen from the side

items.title: Ambient lighting
items.text: Adjustable multi-colour lighting sets the right mood for every trip.
items.alt: V27 rear bench

performance.title:
Golden REEV:
electric power at the wheels
performance.text:
The petrol engine works as a generator and charges the battery when needed.
The wheels are always driven by the two electric motors, one per axle: the quick, quiet response of an EV, with the range for long journeys.
performance.img_alt: Diagram of the Golden REEV range extender system on the V27 platform

groups.title: Golden REEV range extender
groups.lines: Two electric motors, one per axle: electric all-wheel drive. Engine thermal efficiency 45.79%. The petrol engine only acts as a generator. CATL lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery.

groups.title: A quiet cabin
groups.lines: Under 61 dB in the cabin, 2 dB below the industry average.

offroad.title: Where the tarmac ends
offroad.text: Generous angles, deep wading and a very rigid body: iCAUR V27 takes on sand, rocks and dirt tracks calmly.
offroad.alt: The sand-coloured V27 climbs a rocky mountain trail, kicking up dust

safety.title: March forward fearlessly
safety.cage_alt: V27 cage body with high-strength steels highlighted

adas.title: Rear Cross Traffic Alert (RCTA)
adas.text: When reversing it watches traffic coming from the sides and warns you with sounds and lights.
adas.alt: Illustration of rear cross traffic alert

adas.title: Automatic Parking (APA)
adas.text: It finds the space, plans the path and parks by itself, even in tight spots.

adas.title: Active safety
adas.text: It monitors the surroundings in real time, anticipates risks and steps in when needed.
adas.alt: Illustration of active safety systems on the motorway

safety.intro:
A body built to protect everyone on board.
A cage structure and high-strength steels, designed to the toughest safety standards.

groups.title: Cage structure
groups.lines: 11 cross members and 11 longitudinal beams form a rigid cage. 39 key points are made of hot-stamped steel.

groups.title: Five stars
groups.lines: Designed to the five-star standards of E‑NCAP, C‑NCAP, A‑NCAP and ASEAN NCAP.

meta.title: About us — iCAUR Italy
meta.description: iCAUR believes true classics are neither retro nor trend driven. Lasting design, electric technology and a car made to stay with you for years.

hero.title:
Classic
Never Fades
hero.text: Letting classics move forward in the new energy era.

story.text: We believe true classics are neither retro nor trend driven. Time proves them: lasting appeal that transcends eras, and reliability that grows stronger with the years. Chosen by a few, but held with conviction.

manifesto.title:
As technology chases what's newer and faster,
we care about what time chooses to keep.

items.text: For those who choose understated design over showy looks, and know that proportions, lines and balance never go out of style.
For those who enjoy the ease technology brings, yet refuse to be carried away by numbers and fleeting hype.
For those who don't follow the crowd, and value trust built over time.

manifesto.promise: We don't chase extreme specs at the expense of real experience. We don't trade safety for a fashionable outline. And we don't overload features at the cost of long-term reliability.
manifesto.alt: Woman leaning on a sand-coloured iCAUR in front of mountains at sunset
manifesto.short: For those who choose understated design, enjoy technology without chasing trends and value trust built over time. We don't chase extreme specs, and we never trade safety or reliability.

items.title: Classic design
items.text: Timeless aesthetics, refined taste and a quality you can see and feel: a car to be proud of.
items.alt: Sand-coloured V27 in front of a historic building with columns

items.title: Thoughtful technology
items.text: Smart electrification breathes new life into classic design: a drive that is safe, caring and intuitive.
items.alt: Top view of a V27 with driver assistance sensors highlighted

items.title: Open ecosystem
items.text: Open platforms and standard interfaces to personalise the car and co-create new experiences with its drivers.
items.alt: Showroom with iCAUR accessories: seat, bicycle and inflatable boat

items.title: User-centric
items.text: Start with people. Listen first, then design with purpose.
items.alt: Team meeting with colleagues in person and on a video call

items.title: Design-led
items.text: Timeless aesthetics that move you. Design defines our character.
items.alt: Technicians working on a driving simulator

items.title: Innovation first
items.text: Push the boundaries of new energy. Make advanced tech feel effortless and human.
items.alt: Engineer with a tablet in a lab

items.title: Safety matters
items.text: Peace of mind, engineered to the highest global standards and proven through reliability.
items.alt: Welding robots working on a car body in a factory

items.title: Global outlook
items.text: Open to the world. Grow with partners and move mobility forward, together.
items.alt: Earth seen from space at night, with city lights

mission.text: To create a freer, more enjoyable and more trustworthy mobility experience for drivers worldwide, through timeless design and intelligent technology.
mission.alt: Aerial view of a waterfront city at sunset

life.title:
One car,
many worlds
life.text: Timeless design meets refined craft, weaving wanderlust, exploration and the quiet pleasures of daily life into your own story. No rigid scripts: set your own rhythm and let the open road do the rest.
